proposed_from.topic: Fix p>=2 labeled coordinates and an unordered collection of p+1 distinct centered nonsingular Gaussian components generated by one observational acyclic linear Gaussian SEM plus exactly one effective perfect stochastic intervention per node. Do not assume faithfulness; require root interventions to change variance, allow nonroot marginal variance preservation, and condition stability on all component covariances rather than the baseline alone. Correct the ICML 2023 Proposition 10 rank selector with legal p=2 and p=3 counterfamilies. Prove universal recovery of the baseline, targets, DAG, and parameters via coordinate-isolated precision pairs, invariant root marginals, and unique row-support matching; prove a sound-and-complete O(p^4) real-arithmetic membership certificate checking baseline factorization and every surgery; and prove stability under operator error < min(lambda/2, alpha lambda^2/16, g/8), where lambda is the minimum eigenvalue across all components, alpha is the relevant precision support margin, and g is the root marginal gap. Include an open-family impossibility theorem for permutation-equivariant rank-only baseline selectors and evaluate the certificate as a semantic validation layer for causaldag's documented unknown-target IGSP mixture workflow. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Universal baseline orientation, unique target matching, full parameter recovery, membership soundness/completeness, and the resolvent threshold have complete proof spines; fresh exact checks passed 296 legal models, 296 relabelings, an independent small-dimensional explanation enumeration, 200 within-radius perturbations, and four exact near-singular instances. The corrected necessity witness has alpha=1/2. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Derive a concrete unordered Gaussian-component estimator with an explicit operator-error tail T_n(delta) for growing p; current statistical claims are conditional on component estimation. EARLY KILL TEST: Accept both p=2 witnesses and six p=3 legal examples under independent reconstruction; reject the p=3 false positive at baseline factorization; at t=1/100 verify alpha=1/2, positive-definite perturbed covariance, and precision off-diagonal magnitudes 103/97, 1, and 200/97. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The nearest theorem-level result is Squires et al. (2023), Appendix F.2 Proposition 10, whose strict rank-score claim fails on legal two-node models. The replacement uses coordinate support and invariant marginals absent from the rank matrix and includes an open-family impossibility theorem for every equivariant rank-only selector. Kumar and Sinha (2021, Theorem 3.1) uniquely identify intervention tuples and weights for pooled perfect interventions on a given finite discrete causal Bayesian network under positivity and exclusion, but their known observational context removes the hidden-baseline problem. Kumar et al. (2024) instead learn a fixed number of Gaussian mixture components and require separate observational samples plus interventional faithfulness for causal discovery. These results inform but do not provide universal hidden-baseline and target recovery, full parameter identification with unchanged nonroot variance, or a sound-and-complete arbitrary-tuple membership certificate.

seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v202-squires23a, Appendix F.2 Proposition 10 and Appendix G
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed recovers the mechanism through an explicit functional and includes necessity witnesses; it is not a generic do-calculus restatement.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the false lower bound on intervention-versus-intervention precision-difference rank by coordinate-isolated support geometry, then add global baseline factorization for sound membership.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the paper's Proposition 1 because every surgery has rank at most two. Rebuttal: rank loses the baseline-root symmetry and admits nonmember tuples; orientation, unique matching, and global factorization require new arguments.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The obstruction holds on a strict parameter region rather than at one hand-tuned law.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Interrogate the claimed strict rank-score gap by preserving the entire rank matrix under a baseline-root transposition on a strict parameter region.
seed_details.red_team: Only a numerical erratum. Rebuttal: the open one-root-star family rules out every permutation-equivariant rank-only selector, not merely the published score.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The rate and tail object are the statistical kernel; the estimation rung is not used as a bare motif.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the fixed-component Gaussian-mixture learner by separation-preserving centered-mixture clustering, then propagate cluster contamination through effective-rank covariance concentration.
seed_details.destination_search: Anderson et al. (2026) cover growing centered nonspherical mixtures but only under near-disjoint total-variation separation and without the required surgery-specific operator-error tail.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by combining generic clustering with sample covariance concentration. Rebuttal: existing clustering guarantees do not provide the needed per-component operator error under the weak separations implied by effective surgeries, and contamination bias is load-bearing.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Uniform calibration and power, rather than a plug-in consistency claim, are the intended limit-theory objects.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace separate inverse-Wishart minor tests by simultaneous confidence regions propagated through the complete semantic certificate.
seed_details.red_team: A routine confidence-ball wrapper around continuity. Rebuttal: uniform power against nonmembers requires controlling discrete matching, equality strata, and label-switched dependent mixture estimates, which generic covariance balls do not settle.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because the growing-component estimator must be solved first

seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v202-squires23a, Section 5 discussion of fewer than \(p\) interventions
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The intended result is an exact equivalence characterization with indistinguishable-model necessity, not a sufficient recovery condition.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the perfect target matching by a set-valued equivalence relation when some equation rows have no surgery witness.
seed_details.destination_search: Gamella et al. (2022) characterize segregated noise-intervention equivalence under faithfulness, while Squires, Wang, and Uhler (2020) recover an interventional equivalence class from segregated regimes under interventional faithfulness; neither treats an unordered perfect-surgery collection with a hidden baseline.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from interventional Markov equivalence. Rebuttal: the baseline itself and intervention targets are unlabeled, and perfect row deletion changes the equivalence relation before any graph-class characterization applies.

seed_details.anchor: prior proposal eid_covshift_profilequotient_targets, strengthening path on approximate common-range recovery
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: A critical residual and both sides of the collapse frontier would be required; a sufficient-only robustness radius was rejected.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace exact zero row supports by residual-tolerant compatibility and derive the critical off-target residual for singleton collapse.
seed_details.red_team: Equivalent to sampling perturbation under another name. Rebuttal: structural off-target changes persist at infinite sample size and require a set-valued misspecification analysis, not covariance concentration.
seed_details.disposition: dropped for this version because no observable sharp residual frontier is yet derived

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed includes a generic near-singular failure family and does not market a routine resolvent inequality as the whole contribution.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Make the covariance-inverse resolvent uniform over every component and construct a near-singular family defeating baseline-only radii.
seed_details.red_team: Merely Weyl plus the resolvent identity. Rebuttal: the positive theorem alone is standard, but the exact support margin and legal baseline-conditioned counterfamily identify the necessary conditioning interface.

seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v202-squires23a, Appendix H computational complexity and Appendix G membership
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The causal content is limited, so this was not promoted over the semantic identification kernel.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace exact real comparisons by rational certificates with explicit coefficient growth and separation bits.
seed_details.red_team: Standard fraction-free linear algebra once the real-arithmetic algorithm is known. Rebuttal: equality strata and inverse denominators still require a careful bit-separation analysis, but the causal contribution is limited.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The software interface is treated as a consumer rather than inflated into an identification theorem.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Insert baseline and target validation before the conditional-independence and invariance-test interface used by unknown-target IGSP.
seed_details.red_team: A software adapter rather than a theorem. Rebuttal: semantic rejection is mathematically meaningful, but without calibrated component estimation the contribution is best treated as a consumer evaluation, not the kernel.
seed_details.disposition: dropped as a standalone seed and retained as a concrete consumer
